title: Dark Venture - Winner Announcement
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Cm_qVj04z0

Daniel (@dungeondive) announces the winner of the Dark Venture giveaway — the channel's first contest — with thanks to Robert Lemon and Gilded Skull Games for donating the copy and expansion.

The entries ran to happy stories, sad stories and nostalgic ones, with a great many people writing in about the artwork, which Daniel notes tracks: Dark Venture took his Best Art of 2019. The winner is Will Pattinson, and Daniel is refreshingly upfront that the selection was not remotely scientific. He picked the comment that named three things he loves — Dungeoneer, Lone Wolf and Gamma World.

That admission opens into the best minute of the video. Gamma World was probably the first TSR box set he ever bought, from Arthur's Toys in Fresno, California; he grew up reading the Lone Wolf gamebooks and loving Gary Chalk's art. A routine winner announcement becomes a short, unplanned inventory of the things that formed his taste.

There is also a rare direct ask. Daniel says he does not typically push for subscribers, then explains the mechanism plainly: more subscribers means more attention from publishers and designers, which means more games he can give away to viewers. It is the first Dungeon Dive contest, and he hopes there are many more.

----

Picking a giveaway winner on pure gut feeling — the comment that named three games he loved. Fairer than a random number generator, or considerably less?
